build_pipeline_coro: build a pipeline coroutine from a PipelineConfig with max failures and background tasks
create_pipeline_failure: create a PipelineFailure exception from a list of stage name and exception tuples
build_pipeline_node: build a pipeline node graph from a PipelineConfig with configurable queue and hook factories
run_pipeline_coroutines: run all pipeline stage coroutines as asyncio tasks with background task support and error handling
review_PipelineFailure: review the PipelineFailure exception class that aggregates errors from failed pipeline stages
